title: DELIVERY STAFF
description:
Laundry Delivery Staff – Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

* Customer Pickup \& Delivery
+ Collect garments from customers as per the scheduled pickup time.
+ Deliver cleaned and packed garments safely and on time.
+ Ensure the correct garments are handed over to the correct customer.

* Order Verification
+ Check customer name, order number, garment count, and delivery details before delivery.
+ Verify garments and packages for any visible damage or missing items.

* Customer Service
+ Communicate politely and professionally with customers.
+ Handle basic customer queries regarding pickup, delivery, and order status.
+ Report complaints or special requests to the concerned team.

* Payment Collection
+ Collect cash/online payments where applicable.
+ Provide receipts and submit collected cash to the office/accounts team.
+ Ensure accurate payment recording.

* Route \& Time Management
+ Plan delivery routes efficiently to avoid delays.
+ Follow assigned delivery schedules and maintain punctuality.
+ Use navigation applications when required.

* Order Handling
+ Handle garments carefully during transportation.
+ Maintain cleanliness and hygiene of the delivery vehicle/bag.
+ Ensure garments remain properly packed and protected.

* Documentation \& Updates
+ Update delivery status in the company system/app.
+ Obtain customer confirmation/signature/OTP after delivery, where applicable.
+ Report unsuccessful deliveries immediately.

* Vehicle Responsibility
+ Maintain the delivery vehicle in clean and good working condition.
+ Follow all traffic and safety regulations.
+ Inform the supervisor about vehicle maintenance requirements.

* Coordination
+ Coordinate with the laundry processing, billing, and customer service teams.
+ Inform the team about delays, address issues, or customer\-specific instructions.

* Professional Conduct
* Wear the prescribed uniform and ID card.
* Maintain professional behaviour and good personal hygiene.
* Protect customer information and company property.

title: Graduate Engineering Trainee (GET) - Quality
description:
About the Role
 
 We are looking for a 
 **Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) – Quality** 
  to join our Quality team in transformer manufacturing. The candidate will be trained and involved in 
 **quality inspection, testing, documentation, process monitoring and quality assurance** 
  throughout the transformer manufacturing process.
 



  





 This is an excellent opportunity for a fresh engineering graduate to build strong practical knowledge in 
 **distribution and power transformers, electrical testing, manufacturing processes and Quality Management Systems (QMS).** 




  




 Key Responsibilities
 * Assist the Quality team in 
 **incoming, in\-process and final inspection** 
  of transformer components and assemblies.
* Support inspection of 
 **core, winding, insulation, tank, accessories and other transformer components** 
  as per approved drawings and specifications.
* Assist in conducting and recording 
 **routine and type tests** 
  as applicable.
* Learn and support transformer testing activities such as:
* Winding Resistance
* Transformer Ratio / Voltage Ratio
* Insulation Resistance
* No\-Load Loss \& Current
* Load Loss \& Impedance
* Dielectric / Applied Voltage Test
* Induced Voltage Test
* Oil\-related tests and other applicable inspections
* Verify manufacturing activities against 
 **approved drawings, specifications, work instructions and quality standards** 
 .
* Maintain accurate 
 **inspection reports, test reports, checklists and quality records** 
 .
* Assist in identifying 
 **non\-conformities, defects and process deviations** 
  and support root\-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Coordinate with 
 **Production, Design, Purchase and Stores** 
  teams for resolution of quality\-related issues.
* Support preparation of 
 **NCR, CAPA and corrective/preventive action records** 
 .
* Assist in maintaining and implementing the company's 
 **ISO 9001 Quality Management System** 
 .
* Participate in internal quality audits, process audits and customer inspections.
* Ensure proper calibration and identification of 
 **measuring and testing instruments** 
 .
* Assist in maintaining quality documentation and records as per QMS requirements.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives to reduce 
 **rework, rejection and manufacturing defects** 
 .
* Follow all applicable 
 **safety, quality and manufacturing procedures** 
 .



  




 Technical Exposure
 
 The candidate will receive hands\-on exposure to:
 


* Distribution \& Power Transformers
* Transformer manufacturing processes
* Electrical \& mechanical inspection
* Transformer testing procedures
* Quality Control \& Quality Assurance
* **IS 1180, IS 2026 and IEC 60076**
* **Electrical drawings and specifications**
* **ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System**
* **NCR, CAPA and Root Cause Analysis**
* **Calibration and measuring instruments**
* **Customer and third\-party inspections**



  




 Candidate Profile
 * **Qualification:** 
  B.E./B.Tech in Electrical \& Electronics Engineering / Electrical Engineering
* **Experience:** 
  Freshers / 0–1 year experience
* Strong interest in 
 **Quality, Testing and Manufacturing**
* **Basic knowledge of electrical engineering concepts**
* **Ability to understand technical drawings and specifications**
* **Good analytical and problem\-solving skills**
* **Good communication and documentation skills**
* **Willingness to work on the shop floor and testing areas**
* **Positive attitude with a strong willingness to learn**



**﻿**



 What We Offer
 * Hands\-on training in 
 **transformer manufacturing and testing**
* **Exposure to industry standards and quality systems**
* **Opportunity to work with experienced Quality, Design and Production teams**
* **Practical exposure to customer and third\-party inspections**
* **Career growth opportunities in Quality Assurance, Quality Control and Testing**
* **Ideal for:** 
  Fresh engineering graduates who want to build a career in 
 **Transformer Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Electrical Testing and Industrial Quality Management.**

title: Field Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Beta is a dynamic, product\-based software company dedicated to engineering high\-performance digital solutions for a smarter tomorrow. The organization designs, builds, and launches a versatile suite of proprietary software products, ranging from intuitive applications for the general public to robust platforms for businesses and large enterprises. Its solutions aim to simplify daily routines for individual users and streamline complex workflows for organizations, always focusing on immediate value and exceptional user experience. Driven by technical excellence and human\-centric design, Beta develops software that is powerful, secure, and accessible to a wide range of users. Team members join a culture that values innovation, quality, and practical impact.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Field Engineer role at Beta is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Tiruvallur. This role involves providing hands\-on technical support and field service for Beta’s software and related systems at customer locations, including installation, configuration, testing, and maintenance. The Field Engineer diagnoses and resolves technical issues, documents findings, and communicates effectively with internal teams and clients to ensure smooth operations and high customer satisfaction. Daily responsibilities include troubleshooting hardware and software problems, coordinating with project stakeholders, and contributing to the planning and execution of field deployments. The role also requires maintaining accurate service records, adhering to safety and quality standards, and supporting continuous improvement of field processes.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong troubleshooting and technical support skills to diagnose, analyze, and resolve system issues efficiently.
* Candidates should possess field service experience and familiarity with on\-site installation, maintenance, and repair activities.
* Candidates should possess effective communication skills for interacting with customers, colleagues, and cross\-functional teams.
* Candidates should possess project management capabilities to plan tasks, prioritize workloads, and support timely delivery of field activities.
* Relevant qualifications such as a diploma or degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.
* Ability to read and interpret technical documentation and apply practical solutions in the field.
* Willingness to travel locally as needed and work in varied on\-site environments.
* Experience with software deployment, networking basics, or IT infrastructure support is beneficial.

title: Solution Services Domain Architect
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a talented and experienced Solution Services Domain Architect to join our team. This role is responsible for building and maintaining full\-stack service labs, which includes integrating various cloud platforms and applications. The architect will design and implement end\-to\-end test setups that mimic customer architectures, ensuring seamless vertical and horizontal integration. Additionally, they will lead the execution of functional, regression, upgrade, stability, performance, and interoperability tests, developing automated test scripts to streamline the testing process.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Design and maintain full\-stack service labs, integrating applications, networks, and cloud platforms.
* Ensure vertical and horizontal integration across diverse cloud platforms and applications.
* Lead the execution of end\-to\-end test setups, matching NAM customer architectures and gold standards.
* Deploy and maintain automation infrastructure, including pipelines, tools, and scripts.
* Build and manage shared cloud lab environments, providing on\-demand access to domains.
* Keep labs stable, secure, and user\-friendly, ensuring optimal performance and security.
* Automate lab creation, teardown, and maintenance processes, reducing manual effort.
* Utilize scripts, pipelines, and APIs to minimize manual work and enhance efficiency.
* Lead the development of test scripts for automated testing, improving test coverage and speed.
* Track test progress, resolve issues, and validate results against requirements, delivering comprehensive validation reports.


**Key Skills And Experience**
 Must have:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in software development, cloud computing, or a similar field.
* Knowledge of K8s and openstack cloud platforms, networking, and Nokia Core and BA application integration.
* Experience with Nokia automation tools, pipelines, and scripting languages.
* Proficiency in designing and implementing end\-to\-end test strategies.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.


 Good to have:
   

  

* Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, for collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and industry trends.
* A proactive and innovative mindset, driving continuous improvement.


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .
   

  

**Our recruitment process**
 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
   

  

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .

title: Medical coding jobs for Bioinformatics and Biochemist
description:
**Description**
 As a Biochemist, you will engage in various scientific activities focused on the study of biological processes at the molecular level. Your role will involve conducting experiments, analyzing data, and supporting research projects that contribute to advancements in biotechnology and pharmaceuticals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Conduct Experiments: You will perform laboratory experiments to study biochemical processes, such as enzyme activity and metabolic pathways, helping to understand how living organisms function.
* Analyze Data: Utilizing various analytical techniques, you will interpret experimental data and summarize findings in reports, aiding in the development of new products or improving existing ones.
* Collaborate with Team Members: You will work closely with other scientists and researchers, sharing insights and contributing to teamwork that drives projects forward.
* Maintain Laboratory Equipment: Ensuring that laboratory instruments are properly calibrated and maintained will be part of your duties, ensuring accurate results during experiments.
* Follow Safety Protocols: You will adhere to safety guidelines and best practices in the laboratory to ensure a safe working environment.


 To succeed in this role, you should have a strong foundation in biochemistry and a passion for research. You are expected to have excellent analytical skills, be detail\-oriented, and possess good communication abilities to convey complex information effectively. A background in relevant fields, such as BDS, B.Pharma, B.Sc, B.E, or BVSC, is essential. Additionally, a willingness to learn and adapt in a fast\-paced environment will be crucial for your success.

title: Medical Coding Executive
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**
 As a Medical Coder, you will be responsible for converting healthcare services into standardized codes that are used for billing and insurance purposes. This role requires attention to detail and a strong understanding of medical terminology.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Coding Medical Records: Accurately assign codes to medical diagnoses and procedures based on documentation. This is essential for effective billing and insurance claim processing.
* Reviewing Patient Files: Examine patient records to ensure that all necessary information is included for coding. This step helps prevent errors and ensures that claims are processed smoothly.
* Maintaining Confidentiality: Safeguard patient information according to privacy laws and regulations. Understanding and adhering to confidentiality guidelines is vital in this role.
* Communicating with Healthcare Professionals: Collaborate with doctors, nurses, and other medical staff to clarify information related to patient records. This helps ensure accurate coding and understanding of medical procedures.
* Staying Updated on Coding Guidelines: Keep informed about changes in coding practices and regulations. Continuous learning is important to ensure compliance and accuracy in your work.


**Required Skills And Expectations:**
* A background in healthcare\-related education (BDS, B.Pharma, B.Sc, B.E) is essential.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in code assignment is crucial.
* Basic understanding of medical terminology and coding systems is expected.
* Good communication skills are necessary for effective collaboration with healthcare professionals.
* A proactive attitude and willingness to learn will help you succeed in this entry\-level role.

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Sevalaya is a registered charitable trust founded in 1988, working across multiple Indian states including Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Telangana. The organization focuses on education, healthcare, rural development, and welfare, positively impacting over 1 million people. Sevalaya is professionally managed and guided by a dedicated Board of Trustees from diverse professional backgrounds who share a strong commitment to social development. The ethos of Sevalaya, “Love All Serve All,” reflects its inclusive approach to community service and development. Prospective team members can learn more about Sevalaya’s work and culture through its active presence on social media channels.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Human Resources Executive role based in Tiruvallur. The Human Resources Executive will handle day\-to\-day HR operations including onboarding and documentation, attendance and leave management, and coordination of payroll inputs. The role includes maintaining employee records, supporting performance management processes, and ensuring HR policies and procedures are communicated and followed. The Human Resources Executive will address employee queries, support grievance handling, and assist in organizing trainings, engagement activities, and welfare initiatives. The role also involves collaborating with leadership on HR reporting and supporting compliance with statutory and organizational requirements.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong skills in Human Resources (HR) and HR Management, with a clear understanding of organizational HR functions.
* Candidates should possess practical experience in HR Operations, including onboarding, documentation, and HR\-related administration.
* Candidates should possess capabilities in Employee Relations, including handling employee concerns, supporting engagement, and fostering a positive workplace culture.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of HR Policies, including development, implementation, and communication of guidelines and procedures.
* Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field; a postgraduate specialization in HR is an advantage.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks in a structured manner.
* Proficiency in basic computer applications and HR\-related tools; experience in the nonprofit or social development sector is desirable.
* Commitment to Sevalaya’s values, willingness to work on\-site in Tiruvallur, and readiness to collaborate with diverse teams and communities.

title: Warehouse handler
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a Warehouse Handler, you will ensure smooth operations for new supplier parts receipt, production hold parts, and inventory accuracy.
   

  

 You will work with the warehouse team and report to the Warehouse Team Lead and work onsite in Kancheepuram, India.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Manage new supplier parts receipt and tracking in SAP and WMS systems.
* Segregate MRB parts and scrap materials from production and suppliers as per quality guidelines.
* Maintain accurate MRB and scrap inventory records in SAP and WMS systems.
* Perform inventory cycle counts for MRB and scrap stock and execute SAP adjustments on time.
* Post scrap transactions in SAP and ensure compliance with disposal processes.
* Coordinate scrap disposal with approved vendors, ensuring proper documentation (Gate Pass, Disposal Certificate).
* Prepare and maintain scrap and MRB reports using MS Excel and share with Quality and EHS teams.
* Coordinate with receiving an kitting team also will do the supporting role of these functions.
* Ensure safety and environmental compliance during scrap handling and disposal.


**The Essentials \- You Will Have**
* Diploma / Degree in logistics, supply chain management, or a related field is preferred.
* Minimum of 3 years experience in similar field
* Strong knowledge of warehouse management applications and Microsoft Office suite.
* Familiarity with warehouse management systems (WMS) and proficiency in using relevant software applications.

description:

 BCC Martech is a fully integrated brand management agency that specializes in end\-to\-end planning, designing, and execution of brand communication. The agency delivers consistent brand messaging across print, TV, outdoor, digital, and techno\-creative media. BCC Martech combines strategic thinking with creative solutions to help clients strengthen their brand presence. Team members collaborate across disciplines to support diverse campaigns and long\-term brand initiatives.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Client Servicing Executive role based in Poonamallee. The Client Servicing Executive will manage day\-to\-day client interactions, understand client requirements, and coordinate with internal creative, marketing, and production teams to ensure timely and accurate delivery of campaigns. Responsibilities include preparing and delivering presentations, tracking project progress, resolving client queries, and maintaining detailed documentation of deliverables and feedback. The role also involves supporting account growth by identifying opportunities for additional services, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction, and contributing to the smooth execution of brand communication across multiple media channels.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Client Services and Client Relations skills to manage expectations and build long\-term partnerships.
* Candidates should possess solid Customer Service capabilities to respond promptly, handle concerns, and ensure a positive client experience.
* Candidates should possess effective Account Management skills to oversee projects, manage timelines, and coordinate cross\-functional teams.
* Candidates should possess confident Presentations skills to prepare and present proposals, reports, and campaign updates.
* Candidates should ideally have experience in advertising, marketing, or brand management agencies.
* Candidates should have excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment.
